verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bugbot reviewing individual PR diffs with repo-level BUGBOT.md rules and org-wide rules. Nothing documents reviewing changes coherently across multiple repositories, or handling large-monorepo context beyond a single PR diff. Connecting multiple repositories and organization-wide rules are adjacent controls, not cross-repo or monorepo understanding.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer understands changes that span multiple repositories or a large monorepo and reviews them coherently
